title: Housing Potential Common Data Model and City Digital Twin
abstract: arXiv:2605.05535v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The evaluation of housing potential requires consideration of a location from multiple perspectives, ranging from zoning and land use to population characteristics and access to services. This research introduces the Housing Potential Common Data Model (HPCDM) to overcome existing data silos, serving as a standard to support integration and interoperability across the diverse range of datasets that are required for housing potential analysis. This report details the evaluation of the model along with the creation of a City Digital Twin for housing and a pilot dashboard application to demonstrate a practical implementation. Beyond the technical framework, this work identifies critical barriers to adoption and provides actionable mitigation strategies for urban planners and stakeholders.

translated_title: 住房潜力通用数据模型与城市数字孪生
translated_abstract: 住房潜力的评估需要从多个角度考虑一个地点，涵盖分区规划、土地使用、人口特征和服务可达性等方面。本研究引入了住房潜力通用数据模型（HPCDM），以克服现有数据孤岛问题，作为支持住房潜力分析所需多样化数据集集成和互操作性的标准。本报告详细介绍了模型的评估过程，以及为住房构建城市数字孪生和试点仪表板应用程序，以展示实际实施情况。除技术框架外，本研究还识别了采用的关键障碍，并为城市规划者和利益相关者提供了可行的缓解策略。
tldr: 本研究提出住房潜力通用数据模型（HPCDM）作为标准，克服数据孤岛，集成多源数据，并构建城市数字孪生及试点仪表板，以支持住房潜力分析，同时识别采用障碍并提供缓解策略。
en_tdlr: This study introduces the Housing Potential Common Data Model (HPCDM) as a standard to overcome data silos, integrate multi-source data, and build a City Digital Twin with a pilot dashboard, while identifying adoption barriers and offering mitigation strategies for housing potential analysis.
